If chainRequests is included, it is treated as the full set of requests for the chain: any existing chain requests not present in the array will be deleted from the database, and any new request added in the array will be created in the database. This supports full add, update, and delete of chain requests and their extractVariables.

requestBody.description: Request chain update request. You can update: name (required), isImportant (optional), environmentId (optional), and chainRequests (optional, array of UpdateChainRequest). If chainRequests is provided, it is treated as the complete set of requests for the chain: any existing chain requests not present in this array will be deleted from the database. Each UpdateChainRequest requires: id, name, order, method, url, bodyType, authorizationType, authorization. Optional: description, bodyFormData, bodyRawContent, headers, params, extractVariables.
